content:
# Releases are cut by hand and nothing here creates tags: bump `version` in
# js/packages/sdk/package.json in a PR, merge it, then push the matching tag
# (`git tag 0.6.0 && git push origin 0.6.0`). See docs/releasing.md.
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  check-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Tag matches SDK version
        run: |
          version="$(node -p 'require("./js/packages/sdk/package.json").version')"
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" != "$version" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match js/packages/sdk/package.json version $version"
            exit 1
          fi

  vpk:
    needs: check-version
    uses: ./.github/workflows/vita-build.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ github.ref_name }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write

  publish:
    needs: vpk
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          package_json_file: js/package.json

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: js/pnpm-lock.yaml

      # Trusted Publishing needs npm 11.5.1 or later
      - name: Update npm
        run: npm install -g npm@latest

      - name: Install JS dependencies
        run: pnpm --dir js install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build JS
        run: pnpm --dir js build

      # pnpm pack resolves `catalog:` versions; npm publish authenticates over OIDC
      - name: Publish @vitadeck/sdk
        working-directory: js/packages/sdk
        run: |
          pnpm pack --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdk"
          npm publish "$RUNNER_TEMP"/sdk/*.tgz --provenance --access public

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: vitadeck-vpk-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/vpk

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          flags=()
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == 0.* ]]; then
            flags+=(--prerelease)
          fi
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$RUNNER_TEMP/vpk/vitadeck.vpk" \
            --verify-tag --generate-notes "${flags[@]}"
